headline: Anthropic recommends companies consolidate sub-agents into a single agent
body: Anthropic recommends that companies evaluate whether they can consolidate sub-agents into a single agent that loads context on demand. In one comparison, Anthropic says the single-agent architecture ran about twice as fast as the multi-agent setup. It has published a migration kit on GitHub to help teams make the transition.
note: For banks building agents, the cost and latency case for fewer, broader agents may matter more than the number of specialists.
